title: Add WorkflowWavePlan::verify_wave_plan_invariants and adaptive report invariant verifiers in susi-harness
goal: Add WorkflowWavePlan::verify_wave_plan_invariants in workflow.rs, AdaptiveExecutionReceipt::verify_receipt_invariants / AdaptiveMissionReport::verify_report_invariants in adaptive.rs, and AdaptiveSupervisorReport::verify_report_invariants in supervisor.rs, re-exported in lib.rs and wired into susi-harness CLI.
acceptance: WorkflowWavePlan::verify_wave_plan_invariants validates non-empty waves, disjoint scopes within waves, topological wave ordering, and total task count without duplicates; AdaptiveExecutionReceipt::verify_receipt_invariants and AdaptiveSupervisorReport::verify_report_invariants validate backend selection, failover accounting, and latency bounds.
